name.en-US: The Life of Blessed Henry Suso by Himself
name.pt-BR: A Vida do Beato Henrique Suso, por ele mesmo

description.en-US: Suso's life written with Elsbeth Stagel (the Exemplar's Vita): the Servitor's austerities, trials and teachings, with the letters of direction to his spiritual daughter, in T. F. Knox's English of 1865. The Middle High German original (Bihlmeyer 1907) is not yet imported: its only free scans are garbled Gothic-type OCR.
description.pt-BR: A vida de Suso, escrita com Elsbeth Stagel: as austeridades, provações e ensinamentos do Servidor, e as cartas de direção à filha espiritual, na tradução inglesa de T. F. Knox (1865).

sources.edition: The Life of the Blessed Henry Suso, by Himself, translated by Thomas F. Knox (London: Burns, Lambert & Oates, 1865).
sources.description: OCR of the archive.org scan (research/sourcing/_scripts/suso_en.py); chapter titles from the book's contents; running heads removed. Translator's preface not included. Not proofread.
